lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Signal acquired. {player_name}, if you can hear me, the rooftop route is still open.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Helix locked the streets below. Stay high, follow the cyan relays, and trust the phase marker only when it turns solid.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Understood. {subject_cap} won't get another clean trace.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: There you are, {player_name}. The relay says {subject} {be} still in one piece.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The barber and tailor can mask your phase signature. Their changes are cosmetic, but what Helix sees matters.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The overlook relay is east. Sync there before you challenge the junction gate.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Helix Warden's barrier key is stable. The factory elevator can bring you home, but the assembly signal will keep spreading until its engine stops.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The factory relays are clean. Neon Moon is still issuing seed commands, and every one points back to the Oracle.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The Oracle opened an Abyssal breach when it fell. Install a corruption filter before you follow it to the convergence.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The dawn grid is holding, {player_name}. Take your time—the city still has lost routes and weapon signals worth bringing home.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Signal Pair recovered. Daggers favor rapid close attacks and phase repositioning.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Billboard Highway is ahead. Helix patrols are searching for someone with your phase signature.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Then {subject} {have} a trail to follow.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: That crown is rebroadcasting your phase trace straight to Communication Spire.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Then {subject} {have} a transmitter to climb.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Voltage Arc recovered. Charged arrows control long lanes and exposed airspace.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The array is routing Helix traffic beyond the city—to a factory descent and an orbital corridor.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: The route is bigger than one district. Keep the relay open.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Magnetic Rail Grip installed. Cyan rail locks and ceiling routes are now traversable.

lines.speaker: RELAY KEEPER
lines.text: Wake a relay from a warp room and the network remembers it. Transfers only start from another live relay.

lines.speaker: RELAY KEEPER
lines.text: The executive crossing is east. The service gauntlet below still hides confiscated runner gear.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Arc Lance recovered. Its reach controls approach lanes and punishes airborne patrols.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Helix Warden owns the pad ahead. Save now. Its projectile arcs are designed to catch blind teleports.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The Warden is down. Factory access just opened beneath the executive tower.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Good. {subject_cap} {be} taking the fight to the assembly line.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Sub-Level Intake is still live. Orange belts carry cargo—and anything standing on them—straight toward the furnaces.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Then {subject} {be} staying ahead of the sort order.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Sort-line override confirmed. The reversible belts now expose a safe coolant route into the Smelting Core.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Good. {subject_cap} {be} following the cold line through the furnace.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Foundry Maul recovered. Heavy strikes trade speed for armor-breaking impact.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The Smelting Core vents in sequence. Read the blue pressure lights before crossing a molten channel.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Coolant Coil recovered. Staff techniques can now sustain safer ranged pressure through heat zones.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Kinetic Breaker Core installed. Heavy ground strikes can rupture reinforced orange floor seals.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: That breaker core was feeding the repair bays. With it removed, their armored floor seals are yours to open.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: These memory records call the factory an orbital seed forge. The machines were built to assemble something on the moon.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Then the Assembly Engine is the last link before launch.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Servo Pair recovered. Dagger recovery and phase follow-ups respond faster under pressure.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The repair bay just woke the Assembly Colossus. Its shockwaves use the conveyor timing as a weapon.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Relay and save station are stable. In its final phase, wait for the engine flare—the armor only opens during that punish window.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Assembly Colossus is offline. The orbital lift is answering a protocol from the Neon Moon.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Factory secured. {subject_cap} {be} taking that lift to the source.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Orbital link restored. Gravity is forty percent below city standard; your jumps and phase marker will carry farther.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Copy. Short inputs, long arcs, solid ground before the next throw.

lines.speaker: PROTOCOL ECHO
lines.text: NEON MOON PROTOCOL: preserve the Oracle, seed compliant worlds, quarantine corrupted outcomes.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The factory wasn't exporting machines. It was building seed systems for this station.

lines.speaker: PROTOCOL ECHO
lines.text: Cleanroom access is conditional. Anchor-compatible subjects may revisit the sealed shaft cache.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Lunar Prism recovered. Bow charges refract through low-gravity lanes with improved area control.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: These observation records predate Helix. The Oracle predicted the city breach—and ordered the response that caused it.

lines.speaker: PROTOCOL ECHO
lines.text: Security lattice mastered. Bio-Tech observation access transferred to the phasebound subject.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: That shaft was protecting more than the Oracle. The next lab is where the corruption entered the protocol.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Orbit Lance recovered. Its extended thrust stabilizes aerial attacks during gravity inversion.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The growth behind that glass matches the signal leaking beyond Orbital Command. This station has been cultivating the corruption.

lines.speaker: PROTOCOL ECHO
lines.text: Oracle model trained on failed timelines: Cyber City collapse, factory conversion, abyssal convergence.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: It didn't predict the disaster. It rehearsed it.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Oracle Focus recovered. Staff techniques retain lock through abrupt gravity shifts.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Gravity Anchor installed. Inversion fields stabilize around your phase signature, opening anchor-sealed routes.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Anchor confirmed. The Security Shaft cache is reachable now, and Orbital Command can no longer throw you off-axis.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Save here. Lunar Oracle teleports before every pattern and reverses gravity in phase two. Follow the flash, not its last position.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Oracle is down, but its final command opened a corruption breach below the station. The signal calls it Abyssal Night.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Then {subject} {be} following the chain before it reaches Cyber City.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Magenta fields are accumulating corruption in your phase signature. Cross in short bursts until we find a filter.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Understood. {subject_cap} {be} not giving the breach time to settle.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Abyssal Filter installed. Corruption buildup is reduced and corrupted fields no longer deal direct contact damage.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Filter telemetry is clean. The signal descends through the Dark Chasm into a living machine network.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Void String recovered. Bow charges remain stable inside corruption fields.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The chasm relays carry copies of every signal we broke above. The Abyss has been learning our route.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Cleansing Spike recovered. Spear finishers disperse nearby corruption buildup.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: These growth rings contain Helix, factory, and lunar code. The Oracle fed every failed defense into the same organism.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Null Energy Field installed. Dense corruption seals and sanctuary trial gates now recognize your phase signature.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The nest core is clean. One signal remains beyond the Sanctuary: Void Cerberus, guarding the convergence heart.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Sanctuary relay is live. Each chamber repeats one system you've already mastered. Read the primary threat and ignore the noise.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Convergence Edge recovered. Sword finishers project a short null-field wave.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Cerberus combines the whole route: spreads, corruption zones, dash pressure, then a desperation sweep. Your field is the answer, not a shortcut.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Final save is stable. Once you cross, follow each head's telegraph and keep a legal phase return point behind you.

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Mara, keep the city channel open. {subject_cap} {be} ending this.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Cerberus is down. The convergence is collapsing around you—phase to the cyan anchor now!

lines.speaker: {player_name}
lines.text: Anchor locked. Tell Cyber City {subject} {have} its dawn back.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Come home, {player_name}. We'll tell them together.
